title: SP_SU_DUNG_DICH_VU
shortDesc: Stored Procedure để thêm Dịch Vụ cho đơn Đặt Phòng.

separateTables.name: DATPHONG
separateTables.label: 📋 Bảng Chi tiết sử dụng dịch vụ
separateTables.sqlBefore: SELECT ct.datphong_id AS booking_id, ct.dichvu_id AS dich_vu_id, dv.ten_dich_vu, ct.so_luong, ct.don_gia FROM CT_SUDUNG_DV ct LEFT JOIN DICHVU dv ON dv.id = ct.dichvu_id WHERE ct.datphong_id = @DatPhongId
separateTables.sqlAfter: SELECT ct.datphong_id AS booking_id, ct.dichvu_id AS dich_vu_id, dv.ten_dich_vu, ct.so_luong, ct.don_gia FROM CT_SUDUNG_DV ct LEFT JOIN DICHVU dv ON dv.id = ct.dichvu_id WHERE ct.datphong_id = @DatPhongId
separateTables.sqlFetchInitial: SELECT TOP 5 ct.datphong_id AS booking_id, ct.dichvu_id AS dich_vu_id, dv.ten_dich_vu, ct.so_luong, ct.don_gia FROM CT_SUDUNG_DV ct LEFT JOIN DICHVU dv ON dv.id = ct.dichvu_id ORDER BY ct.created_at DESC

separateTables.name: CT_SUDUNG_DV
separateTables.label: 🛎️ Sử Dụng Dịch Vụ
separateTables.sqlBefore: SELECT ct.id, ct.datphong_id AS booking_id, ct.dichvu_id AS dich_vu_id, dv.ten_dich_vu, ct.so_luong, ct.don_gia FROM CT_SUDUNG_DV ct LEFT JOIN DICHVU dv ON dv.id = ct.dichvu_id WHERE ct.datphong_id = @DatPhongId
separateTables.sqlAfter: SELECT ct.id, ct.datphong_id AS booking_id, ct.dichvu_id AS dich_vu_id, dv.ten_dich_vu, ct.so_luong, ct.don_gia FROM CT_SUDUNG_DV ct LEFT JOIN DICHVU dv ON dv.id = ct.dichvu_id WHERE ct.datphong_id = @DatPhongId
